requirements.title: CFI_setpointer has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h pointer-association interface
requirements.definition: CFI_setpointer has the interface int CFI_setpointer(CFI_cdesc_t *result, CFI_cdesc_t *source, const CFI_index_t lower_bounds[]) and updates a descriptor for a Fortran pointer association or disassociation.

pending.CFI_setpointer-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares result and source CFI_cdesc_t pointers plus a lower-bound array, and compiles an ordinary CFI_setpointer call returning int.

requirements.title: CFI_setpointer actual arguments must satisfy pointer-result, source, rank/type/length, and lower-bound restrictions
requirements.definition: The result descriptor shall describe a Fortran pointer, source shall be null or describe an allowed allocated, pointer, or nonallocatable nonpointer object that is not assumed-size, corresponding rank and type shall match, element length shall match except for deferred-length character pointer results, and nonzero-rank nonnull source calls require adequate lower_bounds storage or a null lower_bounds argument.

pending.CFI_setpointer-result-pointer-descriptor: Positive companion establishes result with CFI_attribute_pointer and null base_addr before association; CFI_attribute_other result mutation is nonconforming without required diagnosis.
pending.CFI_setpointer-source-allowed-or-null: Use one source descriptor established over nonallocatable int storage and one null source call to exercise association and disassociation.
pending.CFI_setpointer-rank-type-and-elem-len-ma: Positive companion gives result and source rank one and CFI_type_int with matching element length; type-mismatch mutation is a source-control negative and not a required diagnostic.
pending.CFI_setpointer-lower-bounds-array: Association call passes lower_bounds {-2} for rank one and a companion call passes null lower_bounds to preserve source lower bounds; both calls assert CFI_SUCCESS.

requirements.title: Successful CFI_setpointer disassociates or associates the pointer descriptor and applies lower bounds and deferred character length
requirements.definition: Successful CFI_setpointer makes result describe a disassociated pointer for null or disassociated source, or otherwise describe the source object with optional replacement lower bounds; a deferred-length character pointer result receives source elem_len.

pending.CFI_setpointer-null-or-disassociated-sou: C companion first associates result to int storage, then calls CFI_setpointer(result, NULL, NULL) and asserts CFI_SUCCESS plus result base_addr equal to NULL.
pending.CFI_setpointer-associated-source-copies-: C companion establishes source over int storage values 7, 8, 9, and 10, calls CFI_setpointer with lower_bounds {-2}, asserts result base_addr equals source base_addr, extent is 4, lower_bound is -2, and CFI_address subscript {-1} reads value 8.
pending.CFI_setpointer-deferred-character-elem-l: Mixed Fortran/C companion obtains a descriptor for a deferred-length character pointer result from Fortran, uses a source character descriptor with elem_len 5, calls CFI_setpointer, and asserts result elem_len becomes 5 after CFI_SUCCESS.

requirements.title: Detected CFI_setpointer errors preserve the result descriptor
requirements.definition: After a detected CFI_setpointer error, the result descriptor is not modified.

pending.CFI_setpointer-detected-error-preserves-: C companion establishes a valid source descriptor over rank-one int storage and a result descriptor with matching rank, type, elem_len, and bounds but attribute CFI_attribute_other instead of CFI_attribute_pointer, snapshots result base_addr, elem_len, version, rank, attribute, type, and every dim lower_bound, extent, and sm member, calls CFI_setpointer with lower_bounds {0}, and asserts the returned indicator is CFI_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE from the result-pointer requirement plus every snapshotted result member is unchanged.
